description: quic-go, the pure-Go QUIC implementation behind Caddy's HTTP/3, serving HTTP/3 through its http3.Server with default configuration. Handlers are plain net/http ones routed by the Go 1.22 ServeMux; /static reads files from disk on every request and picks the pre-compressed .br/.gz twin off Accept-Encoding. A net/http TLS listener on tcp/8443 answers the harness readiness probe and is idle during the run.
